Please contact the City Clerk at (310) 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.

We are advised by the members of the Commission that none of them have received campaign contributions within the last twelve months.

No. 091-529). A fee is required for filing an appeal with the City Clerkâ€™s office (R05-14).
The Council may, within fifteen days after the date of the decision or on or before the first date following the first Council meeting after the date of the Planning Commission decision, whichever occurs last: 1) Confirm the action of the Planning Commission and grant or deny the application; 2) Set the matter for public hearing and dispose of it in the same manner as on an appeal; or 3) Amend, modify, delete or add any condition of approval which the Council finds is not substantial under the circumstances relative to or affecting the property subject to the application for a development entitlement. Any determination of the Council pursuant to this paragraph shall be conclusive and final.
The Planning Commission reserves the right to modify the order of items shown on the agenda and advises all interested parties to arrive promptly at the commencement of the meeting.

THIS AGENDA HAS BEEN AMENDED TO INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING NOTICE:
This meeting is being held pursuant to Executive Order N-25-20 issued by California Governor Gavin Newsom on March 12, 2020 to further the State's efforts to control the spread of COVID-19 Coronavirus. Planning Commissioners will attend and participate by teleconference/virtual meeting. Members of the public may also attend by teleconference in order to observe and provide public comment during the meeting. The meeting will not be livestreamed. If you wish to participate, the following process must be followed.
• Thursday, April 15 @ NOON - written correspondence is due to PlanningCommissionMeeting@PVEstates.org If you require a physical letter, it may be mailed to or dropped off at City Hall at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274. Correspondence received by this deadline will be posted online with the staff report.
• Tuesday, April 20 @ NOON - correspondence received by this time will be forwarded to the board and posted online as late correspondence. Email your letter to PlanningCommissionMeeting@PVEstates.org or mail or drop off your letter at City Hall at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates,CA 90274. Correspondence received after this deadline will be forwarded to the committee at the start of the meeting.
• Tuesday, April 20 @ NOON - if you wish to present any visual aids such as a PowerPoint or photos during your public comment period, a PDF is due to PlanningCommissionMeeting@PVEstates.org
• Tuesday, April 20 @ 6:30 p.m. - if you wish to speak during the meeting, you must email PlanningCommissionMeeting@PVEstates.org with (1) your name, (2) the project address on which you'd like to speak, and (3) the phone number and/or Zoom name from which you will be calling in to the meeting. This will replace the in-person speaker cards.
• As soon as possible - To invite Commissioners to view impacts from your home, submit a request in writing to appointments@PVEstates.org.
The meeting will begin promptly at 6:30 p.m. so please prepare and join the meeting in advance of 6:30 p.m. You will be muted upon entry. The host will unmute you when it is your turn to speak. Each member of the public is allotted 3 minutes maximum to present.
The City thanks you for your patience and understanding as we do our best to carry on the public process given current circumstances.

MEMORANDUM
  Agenda Item #:  5
  Meeting Date: 4/28/21

TO:  PLANNING COMMISSION

FROM:  BRIANNA RINDGE, COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DIRECTOR

SUBJECT:  PLANNING COMMISSION ACTIONS OF APRIL 20, 2021

DATE:  APRIL 28, 2021

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Present:  Planning Commissioners Walker, Wade, Lazzaro, Criley, and Nendick
Absent:  None
Also present: Community Development Director Brianna Rindge, Planner Brenna
  Wengert, City Attorney John Cotti

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

  Speakers: None

OLD BUSNESS

1.  NC-1687R-21 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2021-1221); Consideration of a
  Neighborhood Compatibility Revision application for additions and remodeling to
  an existing single-family residence located at 968 Via Rincon. Lot 5, Block 1731,
  Tract 7142. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15301.

  Applicant: Tomaro Architecture, 2617 North Sepulveda Blvd, Manhattan Beach,
  CA 90266
  Owner: Michael & Nicole Fishman
  Speakers: Linda Dotson

  Action: Wade moved and Lazzaro seconded to approve the application (5-0 in
  favor) with standard conditions and: 1. City standard Hollywood berm shall be
  installed per construction plans prepared by a registered Civil Engineer and

Meeting Minutes  Page 1 of 4
April 20, 2021 Planning Commission Meeting  City of Palos Verdes Estates
   approved by the City Engineer; 2. All nonstandard encroachments including, but
  not limited to, the existing nonstandard parking pad and driveway shall be removed;
  3. A standard urban stormwater mitigation plan approved by the City Engineer shall
  be prepared and implemented for the project; 4. The hedge immediately behind the
  garage in the courtyard area shall be lowered to 3’ below the eave of the garage; 5.
  The hedge on the northwest side of the property bordering 964 Via Rincon on the
  property at 968 Via Rincon shall be lowered to the elevation of the ridgeline of the
  proposed addition; and 6. The height of the trees in the courtyard shall be limited
  to 765’ in elevation.

2.  CDP-120-20; (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2021-1223); Coastal Development
  Permit application for additions, accessory structures, and hardscape at the existing
  single-family residence located at 2821 Via Segovia. Lot 6, Tract 23062. This
  project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14,
  Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Pritzkat & Johnson Architects, Inc. 306 Vista Del Mar, Suite A,
  Redondo Beach, CA 90277
  Owner: Matt & Dina Bates
  Speakers: None

  Action: Walker moved and Wade seconded to approve the application (5-0 in favor)
  with standard conditions and: 1. The owner shall provide for the planting of street
  trees adjacent to the site of the building in accordance with the recommendation of
  the Public Works Director or authorized designee. Any property owner requesting
  to deviate from this condition shall be file an application to be reviewed by the
  Parklands Committee, including requests to plant a different tree or a request to not
  plant a tree as required by this condition; 2. A landscape plan and certification are
  required for compliance with the State Model Water Efficiency Landscape
  Ordinance; 3. All nonstandard encroachments shall be removed from any Parkland
  adjacent to the subject property; 4. The project creates 2,500 square feet or more of
  impervious surface area and is located directly adjacent to a Significant Ecological
  Area (SEA), therefore it shall be subject to stormwater performance requirements.
  Furthermore, site planning and design practices shall be employed to minimize
  stormwater runoff as outlined in the Low Impact Development (LID) Requirement
  Guidelines. More specifically, direct connection of area drains to curb and gutter
  shall be avoided as technically feasible. Direct connection to the municipal storm
  drain system shall be avoided; 5. The proposed driveway shall be constructed per
  City Standard; 6. City Staff should confirm that the Consultant (C.E.G. and R.C.E.
  / G.E.) has signed the final dated grading and foundation/construction and
  landscaping plans, per City Code, thereby verifying the plans' geotechnical
  conformance with the Consultant's original report and associated addenda; and 7.
  An as built geotechnical report should be prepared by the project geotechnical
  consultant following grading/construction of the subject site improvements. The
  report should include the results of all field density testing, depth of reprocessing

Meeting Minutes  Page 2 of 4
April 20, 2021 Planning Commission Meeting  City of Palos Verdes Estates
   and recompaction, as well as a map depicting the limits of grading, locations of all
  density testing, and conditions exposed during grading/excavation.

3.  M-1434-21; (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2021-1222); Miscellaneous Application
  for structures exceeding 42” within the setback adjacent to the street located at 1825
  Via Coronel. Lot 14, Block 2, Tract 8043. This project is exempt from CEQA
  pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Dirk Gaudet, Gaudet Design Group, 322 Tejon Place, Palos Verdes
  Estates, CA 90274
  Owner: Hiram Bond & Paul Marcelino
  Speakers: None

  Action: Lazzaro moved and Criley seconded to approve the application (3-2 in
  favor; Walker and Nendick dissenting) with standard conditions and the added
  condition that any vegetation within 5 feet of the front property line fence be limited
  to 5.5’ from grade.

4.  NC-1680-20; (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2021-1224); Neighborhood
  Compatibility application for additions to the existing single-family residence
  located at 2616 Via Ramon. Lot 2, Block 1715, Tract 6885. This project is exempt
  from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3,
  Section 15303.

  Applicant: Jeffrey A. Dahl, 1102 Main Street, Huntington Beach, CA 92648
  Owner: Allen Sanford

  Continued to the May 18, 2021 meeting.

NEW BUSNESS

5.  NC-1688/G-1646-21; (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2021-1225); Neighborhood
  Compatibility and Grading applications for additions to the existing single-family
  residence located at 736 Cloyden Road. Lot 14, Block 1276, Tract 7140. This
  project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14,
  Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Cauthen Design Inc, 25532 Narbonne Ave, Suite 100, Lomita, CA
  90717
  Owner: Junru Pan
  Speakers: Estera Slamar, Damir Slamar, Keith Chumley, Anna Zhang

  Action: Criley moved and Wade seconded to continue the application to the May
  18, 2021 meeting (5-0 in favor).

6.  Zoning Text Amendment regulating building coverage.

Meeting Minutes  Page 3 of 4
April 20, 2021 Planning Commission Meeting  City of Palos Verdes Estates
   Speakers: Marlene Breene

  Action: Criley moved and Wade seconded to recommend approval of the proposed
  ordinance presented by the staff report regulating building coverage to City Council
  with simplification of the language regarding ceiling height and the definition of
  “building” (5-0 in favor).

ITEMS OF INFORMATION

7.  Administrative Approvals – Reviewed and filed.

8.  Art Jury Meeting Schedule – Reviewed and filed.

ACTION MINUTES

9.  Action Minutes from the meeting of March 16, 2021.

  Action: Criley moved and Lazzaro seconded to receive and file (5-0 in favor).

Adjourned at 10:33 P.M. to the meeting on Wednesday, April 28, 2021 at 6:30 p.m.

Meeting Minutes  Page 4 of 4
April 20, 2021 Planning Commission Meeting  City of Palos Verdes Estates
